comment: C-first source-distinct candidate for the monster-to-hero paralysis-claw arm: monsters.h defines a ghoul first attack as AT_CLAW/AD_PLYS 1d2, then a physical claw; mhitu.c:hitmu dispatches the attack through uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping to mhitm_ad_plys. The prior v1-v17 manifest search found no ghoul or AD_PLYS attack case; the v12 thrown-paralysis-potion miss is dothrow.c and does not exercise this monster attack. Four waits after source-created hostile ghoul allow it to close and provide more than one attack opportunity if needed. Inputs frozen before any JavaScript comparison; C must establish whether the AD_PLYS attack is actually reached.
